testCaseName: Login and Verify Personal Information on OrangeHRM Demo
description: Validate that a registered user can log in to the OrangeHRM demo site, navigate to My Info, and verify that the Personal Details section displays a non-empty First Name.

steps.expectedValidation: Login page loads successfully (username and password fields are present).
User is authenticated and navigated away from login page.

steps.target: Dashboard header (CSS: header h6, text equals 'Dashboard')
steps.expectedValidation: Dashboard page is displayed (header 'Dashboard' visible; URL may contain '/dashboard').

steps.target: Sidebar menu item 'My Info' (e.g., XPath: //span[normalize-space()='My Info'])
Section header 'Personal Details' (CSS: h6, text equals 'Personal Details')

steps.expectedValidation: Capture the current value and store it as variable 'firstNameValue'.
The value of 'firstNameValue' is printed to the console/log.
